RULES & ORIGINS

How Hexxagon Works (Rules & Mechanics)

Click to Expand

Hexxagon is an iconic strategy board game invented in 1993 by Software Creations. Played on a tessellated hexagonal grid, it challenges players to clone, leap, and infect adjacent opposing tokens.

01

Cell Duplication (1 Step)

Moving 1 distance to an adjacent hex clones your piece, adding an additional friendly token to the board without sacrificing the original.

02

Tactical Leap (2 Steps)

Jumping 2 distances teleports your piece to an open hex across enemy lines, vacating the initial position for surprise offensive strikes.

03

Infection Cascade

When landing, all enemy pieces touching the target destination are converted to your color instantly, triggering massive point swings.

⚡
TACTICAL PLAYBOOK

Grandmaster Strategies & Pro Tips

Click to Expand

Mastering hexagonal geometry requires spatial awareness and understanding the trade-off between board growth and aggressive leaps.

DEFENSE

Edge & Corner Anchoring

Hexes on outer perimeters have only 3 to 4 neighbors compared to 6 in the interior. Anchoring along edges prevents the enemy from completely surrounding and converting your clusters.

CAUTION

Beware the Reckless Jump

Leaping into open territory leaves an isolated token exposed to counter-infections. Prefer cloning over jumping unless the capture yields a 3+ piece swing or seals an endgame cluster.

CONTROL

Choke Points & Donut Rings

In maps like The Donut Void or Quantum Hourglass, controlling the narrow bridges cuts off the opponent's expansion, forcing them to jump blindly into your traps.

ENDGAME

Chain Reaction Conversions

When the board is over 80% full, single moves can convert up to 6 adjacent hexes in one turn. Calculate multiple moves ahead to ensure your conversion cannot be immediately recaptured.

📖

HOW TO PLAY

1

Clone / Duplicate (Distance 1)Green Ring

Click one of your pieces and select an adjacent hex (1 step). A brand new piece is spawned on the target cell while keeping your original piece intact.

2

Jump / Leap (Distance 2)Amber Ring

Leap across two spaces to reach tactical positions. Jumping moves the original piece to the destination without duplicating.

3

Infection / ConversionCascade Attack

Whenever your piece lands, all neighboring opponent pieces immediately convert to your color! Strategic moves can turn multiple enemy gems at once.

4

Victory Condition

The game ends when all board spaces are occupied or an opponent is wiped out. The player with the highest territory count claims victory!
